# Vendored Icons

`lucide-0.468.0.min.js` is the unmodified browser UMD build from the official
`lucide` npm package, pinned to version **0.468.0**.

- Source: https://unpkg.com/lucide@0.468.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js
- License: https://unpkg.com/lucide@0.468.0/LICENSE
- Local license: `lucide.LICENSE` (includes Lucide ISC and Feather MIT notices)
- Project: https://lucide.dev

No runtime CDN requests are made. The HomeCast PNG is an original, locally
generated raster television mark, not a broadcaster logo.
